batting.name: DPMD Jayawardene
batting.dismissal: c R Dravid b SK Trivedi

batting.name: CM Gautam
batting.dismissal: c SV Samson b SR Watson

batting.name: DA Warner
batting.dismissal: c Sachin Baby b STR Binny

batting.name: R Dravid
batting.dismissal: c AB Agarkar b S Kaul

balls.text: backs away, gets too far from the ball, dabs it to point for one
on a length, outside off, dragged back over the bowler's head for a six. They can use their runs
slower ball, drives hard at it, but gets a thick edge over short third man
full, on off, driven to long-off for one
superb yorker, swinging into the toes, the best he can do is dig it out for a single, which is what he has done
pulled away to deep midwicket

the keeper was doing the right thing, but he has been beaten. Rohrer is moving across to scoop it, Watson follows him, the keeper goes for the angle. Rohrer doesn't get good contact on it, but enough to send this through where the keeper would originally have been. Fifty for Rohrer
charges at him, ends up yorking himself, gets a single to deep cover
drilled towards mid-off, who is up in the circle, but it bounces short of him
full, middle and leg, he does well by getting inside the line to clip this past short fine leg
wide length ball, he wants to go over long-off. Misses
down the wicket, mis-hit towards long-on, which allows him time to come back for two
yorker, on off, 140ks, dug out for one
driven to long-on for one
he took the risk, he got the reward. Short of a length, slower ball, he backs away, gets a bottom edge, which has gone between the keeper and short third man
full and straight, dug out for one to long-on
down the wicket, loses the shape on the pull, gets a bottom edge into the leg side. He comes back for two, and has beaten the direct hit from the deep
slower ball, short, pulled away to deep midwicket
full and wide, swinging away, called wide
short, fast, 141ks, at the body. He gets inside the line of it, but can't do much else
wide down the leg side
short of a length, pitched outside leg, hits him on the pad
short, but wide at that pace is not what you should do. He has cut this over point
through Tambe at point. Driven hard, but Tambe has let this through his legs at point
slower sucker ball, runs off the outside half of the bat, Tambe dives at point, but can't get to it. Watson at third man keeps it in
good comeback. Short, quick, on the stumps. Beats him on the pull
short of a length, outside off, Jadhav tries the cut, but is beaten. This has been a superb over for Royals
slower ball, beaten on the sweep with the low bounce
short of a length, outside off, beaten on the cut
slower short ball, he is already down the track and gets a couple for it
driven on the up, gets just the single to deep cover
short of a length, cut away, but not past point
this time Faulkner won;t be able to save it. Jadhav has got a short ball and pulled this over midwicket
short of a length, outside off, Jadhav looks to work it fine. Beaten
full, on off, defended to cover for one
short of a length, outside off, dabbed away for one
lofted over midwicket, but Faulkner makes a superb one-handed save at the boundary
on a length, on off, defended to cover-point
slower ball, middle and off, worked away against the angle for two
cut away from just outside off, but straight to backward point
short of a length, middle and off, stays back to cut this between point and short third man
short of a length, middle and off, seams in to hit the pad
short of a length, on the pads, worked away for one
short of a length, outside off, punched away to deep cover for one
pushes his last ball through flat, and has been cut away past point for four. Has gone for 0 for 30 in his four overs. Not bad
full, on the pads, bunted towards deep midwicket for one
stays back to a length-ball legbreak. Beaten on the cut
full, middle and leg, clipped away to deep midwicket

appeal for a catch off the toe. Rohrer gets a bottom edge on the sweep, it seems it has lobbed off the boot, but it has also bounced just before hitting the boot. Rightly called not out, but in IPL you never know
full, outside off, nearly a yorker, dug out back to him
what a nothing shot. One of the softest dismissals this IPL. This is neither a slower ball nor does it stop at him. Just short of a length, outside off, but he has flicked this straight to midwicket
short of a length, on off, pushed back to him
lovely shot. He has picked the slower ball, got under it, and lofted this inside-out over mid-off
short of a length, on off, pushed to off for one
moves across to get inside the line of the ball and gets a single to leg. Has taken this from outside off
slower ball, short of a length, outside off, pushed to point
tossed up, slower, 89ks, gets some dip, gets an inside edge on the flick
the first rank bad ball Tambe has bowled. Full, wide outside leg, swept away fine for four
Rohrer moves across the line to try to paddle this away. Gets this off the inside half of the bat, but succeeds in beating short fine leg
tossed up wide, driven to deep cover for one
chipped over extra cover for two
that's the typical MJ sweep. Rarely ever goes wrong with it. Moves across the stumps, gets outside the line of the stumps, and then sweeps it away. Hodge misfields at deep square leg
slower ball, on a length, outside off, pushed to long-on for one
finds point again
short of a length, outside off, finds point again
short of a length, outside off, tries the late cut, but can't beat point
pitched up outside off, but he can't beat mid-off with the drive
on a length, on off, defended back to him
bowled from behind the wicket, floated outside off, MJ dabs at it, but can't beat short third man
flighted, on off, still at 89ks, flicked away for one
short of a length, middle and leg, pushed into the leg side with soft hands for a couple
tossed up, stays quick, 89ks, defended back to him
flighted, middle and leg, driven to long-off for one
full, picked away off the toes
cut away to third man for one
short of a length, on off, no room. Defended
and he is nearly out first ball. This one seamed back in from middle and leg, which suggests it might have pitched in line. But not given. His the outside of the front pad, so could have going down

this is not a slower ball, but it has stopped and jumped at Warner. Short of a length, middle and off, Warner shapes up to force into the off side, but he is done in by that slow extra bounce. Ends up offering a catch to short cover
short of a length, angling in, worked away to fine leg for one
on a length, on off, defended off the front foot
on a length, middle and leg, pushed to long-on for one. No turn, but quick and flat
short of a length, no turn, punched away for one
stays back to push this length ball away for a single
this one goes straight on, at 103ks, doesn't turn, Jayawardene defends
on a length, slight drift in, pitched on off, turned away, defended with an open face
starts with a short ball, pulled away for one
on a length, on off, defended to mid-on
on a length, middle and leg, flicked away to deep midwicket for one
punched away from off, can't beat cover
length ball, on off, pushed with an open face to cover-point
short of a length, on middle and off, seams away a little to beat the outside off
full, outside off, beats him on the inside edge
using all the 143ks of Tait's pace. Dabs on the top of it, past point, and to the right of third man for four
bad ball. Bat Tait. Short, down the leg side, with fine leg up, pulled away for four
gets a bottom edge on the cut, past slip for one
short of a length, just outside off, he backs away to make room, and cuts this between point and cover-point
pushed up wide, full, inviting the loose drive, and succeeds in it. But the thick edge eludes slip
full, on off, defended off the back foot
full, on the pads, pushed wide of mid-on for one
short of a length, pushed outside off, wants a single, but is sent back
short of a length, outside off, skids away to beat his attempt to dab at it
on a length, on off, no room, defended back to him
on a length, on off, dropped to leg for one
on a length, middle and off, defended in front of off
short of a length, outside off, left alone
good first ball. On a length, outside off, seams away a touch, beats the outside edge
CM Gautam's IPL debut hasn't gone well. He drives at a sucker ball outside off, and gets an edge as it moves away
he has hit his bat handle. Or is it the glove? This one kicks from short of a length, and Jayawardene has to drop the bottom hand to dan this to third man
this one seams away from short of a length. Jayawardene pushes tentatively. Is Beaten
short of a length, middle and off, defended back to him
moves across, covers the swing, clips this past square leg
short of a length, on middle and off, seams away to beat his outside edge. That's baptism by fire

back-of-the-hand slower ball, and Sehwag has not picked it. That's the clear sign that Sehwag is not in form. He is the biggest murderer of slower balls because he picks them earlier than others. This one he has swung at in a different time zone. Bowled. They check for a no-ball but more than half of his foot is behind the line
punched away superbly. There are shortish backward point and cover in place, and a deepish cover-point. But he has found the gap for four
short of a length, outside off, defended off the back foot
starts with a half-volley on off, and has been clipped away between mid-on and midwicket
short of a length, outside off, punched away for a single
good Tait, bad Tait. Both of them are here. He has bowled this at 147ks, but has also strayed down leg side
finally he cranks it up. Short of a length, 145ks, kicks away. Samson collects it after head high after Sehwag has said he doesn't want to have anything to do with it
full, swinging away, driven with an open face, but there is a deep point placed for him
short of a length, 140ks, but wide down the leg side
short of a length, outside off, cut in the air, goes one bounce to third man for one
tried the full fast straight one. Wide down the leg side
short, into the pads, 137ks, he has pulled this past short fine leg for four
full, swinging away, 140ks, defended from the crease
full toss, and he finishes it off with a drive to deep cover
full, on the pads, driven to long-on
full toss, pushed to long-on
full, on off, dug out to the right of point for one
full toss, driven to long-on for one
runs off the outside half to third man for one
full toss, smashed to long-on
full, on off, driven with an open face. Warner saves two at deep cover with a big dive
Watto shot. Drives him inside-out over long-off for six. And again this no half-volley. He has done this on the up
yorker, on off, dug out for a single
back-foot drive for six. This is no mean delivery. It is short of a length, he has premeditated, but he goes ahead with the drive, over extra cover, and gets a six
killed past him. This is flighted, on off, and he has smashed this to his left, and the right of long-off
gets a single to long-on
driven to long-off
tries to punch this off the off stump, but hits it straight to cover
short of a length, looks to cut it, but finds point
short of a length, punched to long-on
slower ball, punched away to the right of deep cover where Warner makes a sensational stop
that's a powerful cut. Good luck stopping that. Bludgeoned away over point
driven down the ground, straight of long-on, comes back to two
bouncer, 143ks, Watson ducks under it
full, quick, on the pads, and Watson is off the mark with a four. He has creamed this past through midwicket
punched away past point to bring up his fifty. Watson applauds it
short of a length, on off, pushed to midwicket for one
Kaul slants this too far down leg with the fine leg up in the circle. Guided away for four

Ajit Agarkar, one of India's best fast-bowler-fielders, takes a smart catch at long-on. Short, slower, pulled away down the ground and in the air. Agarkar takes it well overhead. By IPL standards, this was a difficult catch
short of a length, outside off, punched away to deep cover
full toss, he makes room and drives, but gets just the single to deep cover
length ball, into the pads, gets lucky as Rahane misses and gets just the leg-bye
Dravid backs away, Morkel follows him with a short ball, and he mis-hits this towards deep midwicket, which actually allows them time to come back for the second
short of a length, into the pads, concedes a leg-bye
down the wicket, gets another bottom edge to fine leg for two
for the second time in a row Dravid is done in for the pace. This hits the shoulder of the bat even as he looks to close his face. The edge gets him the fifty
short of a length, and rapid, at 143ks. Beaten for pace as he looks to open the face
short of a length, into the body, bunted into the leg side for one. Morkel's throw gives them the second. The keeper hasn't made it up to the stumps
an ordinary end to an ordinary over. Down the leg side, on a length, and all you need is a faint tickle
short of a length, on off, punched to deep cover
short of a length, outside off, beaten on the dab
lovely shot. Full, gentle pace, outside off, driven inside-out, over extra cover for four
pushed to long-off for one
driven on the up, wide of long-off, gets a single
begins with a wide outside off
punched wide of deep midwicket
driven to long-on
Dravid is down the wicket, makes room, and drives this inside-out, and over cover. Umesh Yadav makes a superb stop on the boundary, following in the footsteps of Ajit
driven to long-off for one
down the wicket, drives this powerfully, but can't beat long-on
swept away to deep square leg for one
full and wide, driven to extra cover where Mahela misfields and allows the second. Always happens with Ajit
short, sticks into the pitch, Dravid is beaten on the pull
pushed wide of mid-on for one
the mid-on is up, and Rahane has picked on that. Agarkar bowled short, which is bowling to his field, but Rahane has pulled this down the ground, and over mid-on
driven on the up to long-off
short of a length, on off, punched to long-off
chipped over cover for one
wide down the leg side
backs away to drive this on the up, but gets only a single to wide long-off
full, on the pads, flicked away for one
drilled back towards the umpire, but Negi dives and gets a hand to it
flat, on a length, on off, pushed to long-on for one
cut away, uppishly, but it falls short of point
short of a length again, just outside off, pushed to point
short of a length, outside off, dabbed away to third man
dug in short, rising towards the chest, defended off the back foot
short of a length, outside off, dabbed away to third man for one
on a length, but Morkel's good length is anybody else's short-of-a-length. Defended off the back foot
lucky for Rahane. He is "redefining" T20 batting. Short of a length, gets big on him, he bottom-edges it past the keeper for four
flat, into the pads, gets a single to long-on
Dravid chips down the track to chip this to wide long-off for one
slow through the air, but not full enough, and has been punched to deep cover
short of a length, into the pads, punched to long-on
tries to sweep, but is early into it, and is beaten
full, flat, down the leg side. Called a wide
short of a length, outside off, punched to long-on for one
this is not the way you expect your former captain to treat you. Dravid gets under a length ball and lofts this over mid-of
do we call it a drop or do we call it a life? Slower ball, drilled back at him, and Agarkar gets a hand to it, but the ricochet goes for four. This is how hard it has been hit
worked with the angle, towards deep square leg
back-foot drive. Short of a length, he stands tall and punches this past mid-off
backshort of a length, on off, defended off the back foot
full, on the pads, overpitches, and is clipped away for four through midwicket. Classical shot
short of a length, into the pads, worked away for one
short of a length, on off, defended off the back foot
short of a length, outside off, pushed to third man

dropped by Negi. Rahane tries to drive the shortish ball, but can't control it, and lobs it over cover. Negi goes back, gets under it, but lets it through. However, Warner and Agarkar chase well after it, and keep the ball inside the rope
short of a length, on off, defended off the back foot
short, wide, cut away, but can't beat cover
lovely delivery. Short of a length, 148, pitches just outside off, seams away against the angle, and beats Dravid's fend
full and wide, 148ks, beats him on the drive as this shapes away a little
driven on the up, but straight to cover-point
quick, but on a length and into the pads, and that's drink and meat for Dravid
bouncer, a good sharp one, but beats the keeper and has been called wide too
short of a length, outside off, punched straight to point
slower ball, 116ks, defended off the back foot
full and straight, swinging in late, it has beaten Dravid for pace. But it is also headed down leg
length ball, on off, Dravid is looking to drive this over extra cover, but gets a thick edge over point
too quick again, clipped away along the ground this time, past midwicket
on a length, into the pads, clipped away for four. Over square leg
driven hard, but it goes straight to mid-off. On the bounce
full, on off, runs off the outside half of the bat for one
pulled away to long leg. Not off the middle of the bat
short of a length, kicks off, seams in, cuts him in two. Beaten. They take a bye, though
length ball, into the pads, worked away for one
short of a length, into the pads, worked away past square leg
wide down the leg side
short of a length, the extra bounce beats his cut
Sid Kaul begins with a maiden. Most promising quick bowler in Ranji Trophy last season. Driven straight to point
length ball, in the pads, flicked away, but can't beat the diving square leg
fullish outside off, Dravid drives, is hit on the inside half of the bat
short of a length, 143ks, lands on the seam, moves away, beats the edge
fuller, on off, defended to cover
short of a length, outside off, seams away to beat the cut
